title: Urania designs new gravitational-wave detectors
summary: An algorithm designing interferometers from scratch produced 50 layouts that, in simulation, raise the potentially observable volume by up to 50-fold (best case). Designs are published as a Detector Zoo. Simulation only: nothing has been built or tested.
organization: Max Planck Institute for the Science of Light; and LIGO Laboratory

evidence.tested: Computational study: designs judged against realistic experimental constraints; the best of 50 layouts raised the potentially observable volume by up to 50-fold in the best case; no hardware built or tested.
evidence.unknown: Claimed gains depend on the realistic constraints assumed, which the abstract does not detail.
evidence.ai_role: AI-driven search over detector configurations, treated as continuous optimization, producing interferometer designs.
